comment: Static assets the share viewer fetches at runtime, copied into docs/view/ by scripts/copy-viewer-assets.mjs. Derived by grepping the built bundle for literal asset paths. JSON rather than a JS export so the list has one home that both the build script and its guard test can read without importing across the .mjs/.ts boundary (that import breaks on Windows). logo.json is deliberately absent: it is a per-user guild-logo manifest generated at publish time, not a public/ asset.
